property_summary: For any contract balance amount > 0, when the owner (the deployer/test contract, since __owner = msg.sender at construction) calls sudicideAnyone, the contract is destroyed and its entire balance is paid out to the caller (msg.sender), raising the caller's balance; the mutant self-destructs to address(this), so the balance is destroyed instead of paid out, and the caller's balance never increases.
change_summary: Change the selfdestruct recipient from msg.sender to the contract owner (__owner is not accessible in C, so use payable(address(this)) which refunds the contract instead of the caller).
